  "The guideline corpus recommends surgical excision as the first‑line management for melanoma.",
  "When melanoma is suspected, the whole lesion should be completely excised.",
  "The excision margin should be narrow (1–3 mm) to allow histological diagnosis.",
  "For primary cutaneous melanoma of any thickness or melanoma in situ, surgical excision with histologically negative margins is recommended.",
  "The excision margins should be based on tumor thickness.",
  "If sentinel lymph node biopsy is indicated, it should be performed before wide excision.",
  "Sentinel lymph node biopsy should preferably be performed in the same operative setting as the wide excision."
